system.description:
The power gives the mopor the ability to carefully observe the power patterns that surround an object or creature and discern any powers that have been woven over it. These observable powers were woven using one of the nature of the power woven on the object or creature, and it is helpful if the mopor weaving Read Powers uses the same type. If the mopor uses the same nature, she receives a positive modifier of +2 on the subsequent Situation roll. When the mopor starts e xamining an object or creature, the least advanced (lowest level) power is observed first. The mopor must then succeed on a Situation roll to reveal the power’s secrets. If the object or creature is enchanted with more than one power, the mopor sees

the powers in order of their complexity. The table below shows the Situation values needed to reveal a power. READ POWERS SITUATION VALUES Power Level Situation Value 1 10 2 8 3 6 4 4 5 2 A successful Situation roll means that the mopor has managed to identify a power woven over the object or creature, and also knows how to activate that magic in things such as magical items. If the mopor fails to discern a power, she cannot proceed to reading the next power. A failure still makes it apparent to the mopor that there are one or more powers woven over the object, but not which ones. Read Powers can also be used to discover if a creature has one or more magical abilities, but not what they are.
system.summary: Reveals the traces of power and the powers woven around a creature or an object.
